The '''Crustai system''' lay on the frontier of the [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Chiss Ascendancy]].<ref name="OBF" /> The second [[Planet/Legends|planet]], also known as [[Crustai]], was developed by the Chiss as a colony, while an [[Unidentified asteroid (Crustai system)|asteroid]] in the [[Star system/Legends|system]] served as the [[Crustai asteroid base|headquarters]] for [[Picket Force Two/Legends|Picket Force Two]] of the [[Chiss Expansionary Fleet/Legends|Chiss Expansionary Fleet]]. The system's name was an acronym.<ref name="OBF" />
